question: D is the midpoint of side BC of ΔABC. Point E lies on AC such that CE = AC/3. BE and AD intersect at G. What is AG/GD?
question_hi: D, ΔABC की भुजा BC का मध्य बिंदु है। बिंदु E, AC पर स्थित है इस प्रकार कि CE = AC/3. BE और AD, G पर प्रतिच्छेदित करते है। AG/GD का मान क्या है?
solution:
Given:

D is the midpoint of side BC of ΔABC 

CE = AC/3 

BE and AD intersect at G 

Calculations:

Let DP is parallel to BE 

In ΔBCE and ΔDCP 

∠CEB = ∠CPD (The corresponding angles between two parallel lines are equal)

∠CBE = ∠CDP ( The corresponding angles between two parallel lines are equal)

By AA (Rule of similarity), ΔBCE ∼ ΔDCP 

∴ (BC/DC) = (CE/CP) 

⇒ (BD + DC)/DC = (CP + PE)/CP

⇒ BD/DC + 1 = 1 + PE/CP

⇒ 1/1 = PE/CP

⇒ PE = CP = CE/2 

⇒ PE/CE = 1/2

In ΔADP and ΔAGE 

∠ADP = ∠AGE 

∠APD = ∠AEG  

By AA (Rule of similarity),ΔADP ∼ ΔAGE  

∴ (AD/AG) = (AP/AE)

⇒ (AG + GD)/AG = (AE + PE)/AE 

⇒ 1 + GD/AG = 1 + PE/AE 

⇒ GD/AG = PE/AE 

⇒ AG/GD = AE/PE

⇒ AG/GD = AE/(CE/2)

⇒ AG/GD = 2 × AE/CE 

⇒ AG/GD = 2 × 2/1 

⇒ AG/GD = 4 ∶ 1 

∴ AG/GD = 4 ∶ 1

Alternate Method

Given,

D is the midpoint of side BC

So, BD : DC = 1 : 1

Point E lies on AC such that CE = AC/3

So, AC : CE = 3 : 1

So, CE is 1 and AE = AC - CE

So, AE = 2

AE : CE = 2 : 1

From the following figure balancing sides of the triangle, then

LCM of 2, 1, 1 and 1 is 2

∴ AG : GD = 4 : 1

question: If 16a<sup>4</sup> + 36a<sup>2</sup>b<sup>2</sup> + 81b<sup>4</sup> = 91 and 4a<sup>2</sup> + 9b<sup>2</sup> – 6ab = 13, then what is the value of 3ab?
question_hi: यदि 16a<sup>4</sup> + 36a<sup>2</sup>b<sup>2</sup> + 81b<sup>4</sup> = 91 और 4a<sup>2</sup> + 9b<sup>2</sup> – 6ab = 13 है, तो 3ab का मान क्या है?
solution:
Shortcut Trick

The product 16a4 + 36a2b2 + 81b4 is the product of factors (4a2 + 9b2 + 6ab) and (4a2 + 9b2 − 6ab).

Given: 13 × (4a2 + 9b2 + 6ab) = 91 ⇒ (4a2 + 9b2 + 6ab) = 7.

To find 3ab, use the difference of factors: 12ab = 7 − 13 = −6.

3ab = −6 ÷ 4 = −3/2.

∴ The correct answer is −3/2.

Alternate Method

Given:

16a4 + 36a2b2 + 81b4 = 91

4a2 + 9b2 − 6ab = 13

Formula Used:

(x2 + xy + y2)(x2 − xy + y2) = x4 + x2y2 + y4

Calculations:

⇒ (4a2 + 9b2 + 6ab)(4a2 + 9b2 − 6ab) = 16a4 + 36a2b2 + 81b4

⇒ (4a2 + 9b2 + 6ab) × 13 = 91

⇒ 4a2 + 9b2 + 6ab = 7 ----(Equation 1)

⇒ 4a2 + 9b2 − 6ab = 13 ----(Equation 2)

Subtracting Equation 2 from Equation 1:

⇒ (4a2 + 9b2 + 6ab) − (4a2 + 9b2 − 6ab) = 7 − 13

⇒ 12ab = −6

⇒ 3ab = −6 ÷ 4

⇒ 3ab = −3/2

∴ The correct answer is −3/2.

Additional Information

Algebraic Identity for Quartic Expressions

The identity (x4 + x2y2 + y4) = (x2 + xy + y2)(x2 − xy + y2) is frequently used in competitive exams to solve for specific terms like xy or (x2 + y2).

Sum of Squares Calculation

If the question asked for 4a2 + 9b2, you would add the two factors and divide by 2: (7 + 13) ÷ 2 = 10.

Standard Format

For any equation a4 + a2b2 + b4 = K, if (a2 + b2 + ab) = x, then (a2 + b2 − ab) = K/x.

question: Pipes A and B can fill a tank in 10 hours and 40 hours respectively. C is an outlet pipe attached to the tank. If all the three pipes are opened simultaneously, it takes 80 minutes more time than  A and B together takes to fill the tank. If A and B kept open for 7 hours and closed and then C opened. How much time will C take to empty the tank :
question_hi: पाइप A और B क्रमशः 10 घंटे और 40 घंटे में एक टंकी को भर सकते हैं। C एक निकासी पाइप है जो टंकी से जुड़ा है। यदि तीनों पाइप एक साथ खोले जाते हैं, तो A और B मिलकर टंकी को भरने में जितना समय लेते हैं उससे 80 मिनट अधिक समय लगता है A और B को 7 घंटे खुला रखा जाता है और फिर बंद कर दिया जाता है और C को खोल दिया जाता है। अब C टंकी को खाली कर देगा:
solution:
Total work = 40

Time taken to fill the tank A and B together = 40/(1 + 4) = 8 hrs

Let the efficiency of C be x.

If all three pipe A, B and outlet pipe C open, time taken to fill the tank = 8 hr + 80 min = 9 + 1/3 = 28/3 hrs

Efficiency of A,  B and C = 40/(28/3) = 30/7

According to the question

4 + 1 + x = 30/7

⇒ x = 30/7 – 5

⇒ x = (–5/7)

Work done by A and B in 7 hrs = (4 + 1) × 7 = 35

∴ Pipe C empty the tank filled by A and B in 7 hrs = 35/(5/7) = 49 hrs

question: The average of 24 numbers is 56. The average of the first 10 numbers is 71.7 and that of the next 11 number is 42. Then next three numbers (i.e 22<sup>nd</sup>, 23<sup>rd</sup>, and 24<sup>th</sup>) are in the ratio 1/2 : 1/3 : 5/12 What is the average of the 22<sup>nd</sup> and 24<sup>th</sup> numbers?
question_hi: 24 संख्याओं का औसत 56 है। प्रथम 10 संख्याओं का औसत 71.7 है और अगली 11 संख्याओं का औसत 42 है। इसके बाद अगली तीन संख्याएँ (अर्थात 22, 23 और 24) 1/2 : 1/3 : 5/12 के अनुपात में हैं। 22वीं और 24वीं संख्याओं का औसत क्या है?
solution:
Average of 24 numbers = 56

Sum of 24 numbers = 56 × 24 = 1344

Average of first 10 numbers = 71.7

Sum of first 10 numbers = 71.7 × 10 = 717

Average of next 11 numbers = 42

Sum of next 11 numbers = 42 × 11 = 462

Sum of 22nd, 23rd and 24th = 1344 – 717 – 462 = 165

Ratio of 22nd, 23rd and 24th = 1/2 : 1/3 : 5/12 = 12/2 : 12/3 : (12 × 5)/12 = 6 : 4 : 5

Ratio of 22nd, 23rd and 24th = 6x : 4x : 5x

6x + 4x + 5x = 165

⇒ 15x = 165

⇒ x = 11

22nd number = 6x = 6 × 11 = 66

24th number = 5x = 5 × 11 = 55

∴ Average of 22nd and 24th number = (66 + 55)/2 = 121/2 = 60.5

Short Trick:

Average of 24 numbers = 56

Deviation on first 10 numbers = (56 – 71.7) × 10 = –157

Deviation on next 11 numbers = (56 – 42) 11 = 154

Sum of 22nd, 23rd and 24th = 56 × 3 – 157 + 154 = 168 – 3 = 165

Ratio of 22nd, 23rd and 24th = 1/2 : 1/3 : 5/12 = 12/2 : 12/3 : (12 × 5)/12 = 6 : 4 : 5

Average of 22nd and 24th number = (6 + 5)/2 = 5.5

6 + 4 + 5 = 15 unit

⇒ 15 unit = 165

⇒ 1 unit = 11

⇒ 5.5 unit = 60.5

question: The ratio of the ages of A and B 8 years ago was 2 : 3. Four years ago, the ratio of their ages was 5 : 7. What will be the ratio of their ages 8 years from now?
question_hi: A और B की आयु का अनुपात 8 वर्ष पहले 2: 3 था। 4 वर्ष पहले उनकी आयु का अनुपात 5: 7 था। अब से 8 वर्ष के बाद उनकी आयु का अनुपात क्या होगा?
solution:
Shortcut Trick

Multiply 8 years ago ratio (2 : 3) by 2 → 4 : 6 to equalize age difference with 4 years ago ratio (5 : 7).

Change in parts = 5 − 4 = 1 unit, which corresponds to the 4 years passed.

Time gap from 4 years ago to 8 years from now is 12 years ⇒ 12 ÷ 4 = 3 units.

New ratio 8 years from now = (5 + 3) : (7 + 3) = 8 : 10 = 4 : 5.

∴ The correct answer is 4 : 5.

Alternate Method

Given:

Ratio of A's age to B's age 8 years ago = 2 : 3

Ratio of their ages 4 years ago = 5 : 7

Calculations:

⇒ Let the ages of A and B 8 years ago be 2x and 3x respectively.

⇒ 4 years ago, A's age = 2x + 4 and B's age = 3x + 4

⇒ According to the question, (2x + 4) / (3x + 4) = 5 / 7

⇒ 7 × (2x + 4) = 5 × (3x + 4)

⇒ 14x + 28 = 15x + 20

⇒ 15x − 14x = 28 − 20

⇒ x = 8

⇒ Present age of A = 2x + 8 = 2 × 8 + 8 = 24 years

⇒ Present age of B = 3x + 8 = 3 × 8 + 8 = 32 years

⇒ A's age 8 years from now = 24 + 8 = 32 years

⇒ B's age 8 years from now = 32 + 8 = 40 years

⇒ Required ratio = 32 : 40 = 4 : 5

∴ The correct answer is 4 : 5.

Additional Information

Constant Age Difference

The difference between the ages of two individuals always remains constant. Equalizing the horizontal difference between ratio parts simplifies age problems without requiring algebraic equations.

Cross-Multiplication Method

If initial ratio a : b changes to final ratio c : d after adding time periods x and y, you can apply the cross-product rule: (a × d) − (b × c) = (c × y) − (d × x) to solve directly.

Ratio Properties

Multiplying or dividing both terms of a ratio by the same non-zero number does not change its value. A duplicate ratio of a : b is given as a2 : b2.

question: If \({x^2} - 2\sqrt 5 x + 1 = 0,\) then what is the value of \({x^5} + \frac{1}{{{x^5}}}\)?

solution:

Divide by x

⇒ x2 + 1/x2 + 2 = 20

⇒ x2 + 1/x2 = 20 – 2

⇒ x3 + 1/x3 = 40√5 – 6√5 = 34√5

⇒ x3 + 1/x3 = 34√5      ------ (3)

⇒ x5 + 1/x5 = 612√5 – (x + 1/x)

⇒ x5 + 1/x5 = 612 √5 – 2 √5

⇒ x5 + 1/x5 = 610 √5

⇒ x5 + 1/x5 = (a2 – 2)(a3 – 3a) – a

If x + 1/x = 2√5, then

⇒ x5 + 1/x5 = (20 – 2) (40√5 – 6√5) – 2√5 = 18 × 34√5 – 2√5 = 610√5

question: Two chords AB and CD of a circle with centre O intersect each other at P. fi ∠ APC = 95° and ∠ AOD = 110°.∠BOC is:
question_hi: केंद्र O वाले वृत्त कि दो जीवा AB और CD एक दूसरे को बिंदु P पर प्रतिच्छेदित करती हैं। यदि ∠APC = 95° और ∠AOD = 110° है। ∠BOC कितना है?
solution:
Shortcut Trick

The angle between two intersecting chords is half the sum of the central angles of the intercepted arcs.

⇒ ∠APD = 180° − ∠APC = 180° − 95° = 85°

⇒ ∠APD = (∠AOD + ∠BOC) ÷ 2

⇒ 85° = (110° + ∠BOC) ÷ 2

⇒ 170° = 110° + ∠BOC

⇒ ∠BOC = 60°

∴ The correct answer is 60°.

Alternate Method

Given:

∠APC = 95° (Angle between chords AB and CD)

∠AOD = 110° (Central angle subtended by arc AD)

Formula Used:

The measure of an angle formed by two chords intersecting inside a circle is half the sum of the measures of the intercepted arcs (central angles).

Calculations:

⇒ Chords AB and CD intersect at P.

⇒ ∠APC and ∠APD are linear pair angles.

⇒ ∠APD = 180° − ∠APC

⇒ ∠APD = 180° − 95° = 85°

⇒ By the Intersecting Chords Angle Theorem:

⇒ ∠APD = (Measure of arc AD + Measure of arc BC) ÷ 2

⇒ ∠APD = (∠AOD + ∠BOC) ÷ 2

⇒ 85° = (110° + ∠BOC) ÷ 2

⇒ 170° = 110° + ∠BOC

⇒ ∠BOC = 170° − 110°

⇒ ∠BOC = 60°

∴ The correct answer is 60°.

Additional Information

Intersecting Chords Theorem (Internal)

If two chords AB and CD intersect at a point P inside a circle, then PA × PB = PC × PD.

Central Angle and Arc Measure

The measure of a central angle is equal to the measure of its intercepted arc. The total measure of a circle is 360°.

Angle Subtended at Circumference

The angle subtended by an arc at the center is double the angle subtended by it at any point on the remaining part of the circle.

question: Sides AB and DC of a cyclic quadrilateral ABCD are produced to meet at E, and sides AD and BC are produced to meet at F. ∠ADC = 75°, and ∠BEC = 52°, then the difference between ∠BAD and ∠AFB is:
question_hi: एक चक्रीय चतुर्भुज ABCD की भुजा AB और DC को आगे बढ़ाया जाता है जो जाकर E मिलते हैं, और AD और BC को आगे इस प्रकार बढ़ाया जाता है कि वह F पर मिलते हैं। ∠ADC = 75° और ∠BEC = 52° है, तो ∠BAD और ∠AFB के बीच का अंतर है:
solution:

As we know, In a cyclic quadrilateral, the sum of opposite angles are 180°.

⇒ ∠ABC = 180° – 75° = 105°

In ΔAFB

∠BAF + ∠ABF + ∠AFB = 180°

⇒ ∠AFB = 180° – 53° – 105° = 22°

∴ Difference between ∠BAD and ∠AFB = 53° – 22° = 31°

question: A shopkeeper bought 80 kg of rice at a discount of 10% Besides 1 kg rice was offered free to him on the purchase of every 20 kg rice. If he sells the rice at the marked price, his profit percentage will be:
question_hi: एक दुकानदार ने 10% की छूट पर 80 किलो चावल खरीदता है इसके अलावा प्रति 20 किलो चावल की खरीद पर उसे 1 किलो चावल मुफ्त दिया जाता है। यदि वह अंकित मूल्य पर चावल बेचता है, तो उसका लाभ प्रतिशत होगा:
solution:
Shortcut Trick

Let the Marked Price (MP) of 1 kg rice be 1 unit.

Total rice received = 80 + (80 ÷ 20) × 1 = 80 + 4 = 84 kg.

Total Marked Price of 84 kg rice = 84 units.

Cost Price (CP) for 80 kg at 10% discount = 80 × 0.9 = 72 units.

Profit % = (84 − 72) ÷ 72 × 100 = 12 ÷ 72 × 100 = 1/6 × 100 = 16(2/3)%.

∴ The correct answer is 16(2/3)%.

Alternate Method

Given: MP of 1 kg rice = Rs. 10; Discount = 10%; Free rice = 1 kg for every 20 kg.

Formulas: CP = MP × (100 − Discount%) ÷ 100 | Profit % = (Total SP − Total CP) ÷ Total CP × 100

⇒ Total quantity received = 80 kg + (80/20) kg free = 84 kg.

⇒ Cost Price (CP) for shopkeeper = (80 kg × Rs. 10) × 0.90 = Rs. 720.

⇒ Selling Price (SP) at Marked Price = 84 kg × Rs. 10 = Rs. 840.

⇒ Profit = 840 − 720 = Rs. 120.

⇒ Profit % = (120 ÷ 720) × 100 = 1/6 × 100 = 16(2/3)%.

∴ The correct answer is 16(2/3)%.

Additional Information

Free Items Concept

When items are offered free, the effective cost price per unit decreases. Net discount % = [Free items ÷ (Paid items + Free items)] × 100.

Successive Discounts

The shopkeeper receives a double benefit: a direct cash discount and a quantity discount. Total Profit % = [(Total SP − Total CP) ÷ Total CP] × 100.
solution_hi:
Shortcut Trick

माना 1 किग्रा चावल का अंकित मूल्य (MP) 1 इकाई है।

प्राप्त कुल चावल = 80 + (80 ÷ 20) × 1 = 80 + 4 = 84 किग्रा।

84 किग्रा चावल का कुल अंकित मूल्य = 84 इकाई।

10% छूट पर 80 किग्रा का क्रय मूल्य (CP) = 80 × 0.9 = 72 इकाई।

लाभ % = (84 − 72) ÷ 72 × 100 = 12 ÷ 72 × 100 = 1/6 × 100 = 16(2/3)%।

∴ सही उत्तर 16(2/3)% है।

Alternate Method

दिया गया है: 1 किग्रा चावल का MP = रु. 10; छूट = 10%; मुफ्त चावल = प्रत्येक 20 किग्रा पर 1 किग्रा।

सूत्र: CP = MP × (100 − छूट%) ÷ 100 | लाभ % = (कुल SP − कुल CP) ÷ कुल CP × 100

⇒ प्राप्त कुल मात्रा = 80 किग्रा + (80/20) किग्रा मुफ्त = 84 किग्रा।

⇒ दुकानदार के लिए क्रय मूल्य (CP) = (80 किग्रा × रु. 10) × 0.90 = रु. 720।

⇒ अंकित मूल्य पर विक्रय मूल्य (SP) = 84 किग्रा × रु. 10 = रु. 840।

⇒ लाभ = 840 − 720 = रु. 120।

⇒ लाभ % = (120 ÷ 720) × 100 = 1/6 × 100 = 16(2/3)%।

∴ सही उत्तर 16(2/3)% है।

Additional Information

मुफ्त वस्तुओं की अवधारणा (Free Items Concept)

जब वस्तुएं मुफ्त दी जाती हैं, तो प्रति इकाई प्रभावी क्रय मूल्य कम हो जाता है। शुद्ध छूट % = [मुफ्त वस्तुएं ÷ (भुगतान की गई वस्तुएं + मुफ्त वस्तुएं)] × 100.

क्रमिक छूट (Successive Discounts)

दुकानदार को दोहरा लाभ मिलता है: एक प्रत्यक्ष नकद छूट और एक मात्रात्मक छूट। कुल लाभ % = [(कुल SP − कुल CP) ÷ कुल CP] × 100.

question: In ΔABC, ∠B = 90°, AB = 5 cm and BC = 12 cm the bisector of ∠A meets BC at D. What is the length of AD?

question: The diagonal of a square A is (a + b) units. What is the area (in square units) of the square drawn on the diagonal of square B whose area is twice the area of A?
question_hi: एक वर्ग A का विकर्ण (a + b) इकाई है। वर्ग B जिसका क्षेत्रफल A के क्षेत्रफल का दोगुना है उसके विकर्ण पर खींचे गए वर्ग का क्षेत्रफल (वर्ग इकाइयों में) क्या होगा?
solution:
As we know,

Diagonal of square = √2 a

Area of square = a2

Area of square = (diagonal)2/2

Diagonal of square A = (a + b)

Area of square A = (a + b)2/2

Area of square B = 2 × Area of square A

Area of square B = 2 × (a + b)2/2 = (a + b)2

Side of square B = √(a + b)2 = (a + b)

Diagonal of square B = √2 (a + b)

Given,

Side of other square = diagonal of square B = √2 (a + b)

Area of other square = √2 (a + b) × √2 (a + b) = 2 (a + b)2

Other Method:

Let a = b = 1, then

Diagonal of square A = 2

Area of square A = 22/2 = 2

Area of square B = 2 × 2 = 4

Sides of square B = √4 = 2

Diagonal of square B = 2 √2

Given,

Side of other square  = diagonal of square B = 2 √2

Area of other square = 2 √2 × 2 √2 = 8

From option 3

2 (a + b)2

⇒ 2 (1 + 1)2

⇒ 2 × 4

⇒ 8 (satisfied)
solution_hi:
जैसा कि हम जानते हैं,

वर्ग का विकर्ण = √2 a

वर्ग का क्षेत्रफल = a2

वर्ग का क्षेत्रफल = (विकर्ण)2/2

वर्ग A का विकर्ण  = (a + b)

वर्ग A का क्षेत्रफल = (a + b)2/2

वर्ग B का क्षेत्रफल = 2 × वर्ग A का क्षेत्रफल

वर्ग B का क्षेत्रफल = 2 × (a + b)2/2 = (a + b)2

वर्ग B की भुजा = √(a + b)2 = (a + b)

वर्ग B का विकर्ण = √2 (a + b)

दिया है,

अन्य वर्ग की भुजा = वर्ग B का विकर्ण = √2 (a + b)

अन्य वर्ग का क्षेत्रफल = √2 (a + b) × √2 (a + b) = 2 (a + b)2

अन्य विधि:

माना a = b = 1, तब

वर्ग A का विकर्ण = 2

वर्ग A का क्षेत्रफल = 22/2 = 2

वर्ग B का क्षेत्रफल = 2 × 2 = 4

वर्ग B की भुजा = √4 = 2

वर्ग B का विकर्ण = 2 √2

दिया है,

अन्य वर्ग की भुजा = वर्ग B का विकर्ण = 2 √2

अन्य वर्ग का क्षेत्रफल = 2 √2 × 2 √2 = 8

विकल्प 3 से

2 (a + b)2

⇒ 2 (1 + 1)2

⇒ 2 × 4

⇒ 8 (संतुष्ट)

question: In an examination in which the full marks were 500, A scored 25% more marks than B, B scored 60% more marks than C and C scored 20% less marks than D. If A scored 80% marks, then the percentage of marks obtained by D is:
question_hi: एक परीक्षा पूर्णांक 500 था। उस परीक्षा में A ने B की तुलना में 25% अधिक अंक प्राप्त किए, B ने C की तुलना में 60% अधिक अंक प्राप्त किए और C ने D की तुलना में 20% कम अंक प्राप्त किए। यदि A ने 80% अंक प्राप्त किए, तो D द्वारा प्राप्त अंकों का प्रतिशत है:
solution:
Maximum marks of the examination = 500

A scored = 500 × (80/100) = 400

B scored = 400 × (100/125) = 320

C scored = 320 × (100/160) = 200

D scored = 200 × (100/80) = 250

Percentage of D = 250/500 × 100 = 50%

Other method:

Ratio of A to B = 5 : 4

Ratio of B to C = 8 : 5

Ratio of C to D = 4 : 5

Taking only ratio A to D = 160 : 100

Divide by 2 only, then A : D = 80 : 50

If A got 80%, then D got 50%
solution_hi:
परीक्षा के अधिकतम अंक = 500

A द्वारा प्राप्त = 500 × (80/100) = 400

B द्वारा प्राप्त = 400 × (100/125) = 320

C द्वारा प्राप्त = 320 × (100/160) = 200

D द्वारा प्राप्त = 200 × (100/80) = 250

D का प्रतिशत = 250/500 × 100 = 50%

अन्य विधि:

A और B का अनुपात = 5 : 4

B और C का अनुपात = 8 : 5

C और D का अनुपात = 4 : 5

केवल A और D का अनुपात लेने पर = 160 : 100

केवल 2 से विभाजित, तब A : D = 80 : 50

यदि A ने 80% प्राप्त किया, तो D ने 50% प्राप्त किए हैं।

question: If 5 sin θ = 4, then the value of \(\frac{{sec\theta + 4\cot \theta }}{{4tan\theta - 5cos\theta }}\) is:
question_hi: यदि 5 sin θ = 4, तब \(\frac{{sec\theta + 4\cot \theta }}{{4tan\theta - 5cos\theta }}\) का मान है:
solution:
Given:

5 sin θ = 4

∴  sin θ = 4/5

We have to calculate the value of \(\frac{{sec\theta + 4\cot \theta }}{{4tan\theta - 5cos\theta }}\)

Calculation:

Perpendicular = P, Hypotenuse = H and Base = B.

sin θ = P/H = 4/5

P = 4 and H = 5

As we know,

H2 = P2 + B2

⇒ 52 = 42 + B2

⇒ B2 = 25 – 16 = 9

⇒ B = √9 = 3

⇒ cos θ = B/H = 3/5

⇒ sec θ = 1/cos θ = 5/3

tan θ = P/B = 4/3

cot θ = 1/tan θ = 3/4

Now,

\(\frac{{sec\theta + 4\cot \theta }}{{4tan\theta - 5cos\theta }}\)

\( \Rightarrow \frac{{\frac{5}{3} + 4 \times \frac{3}{4}}}{{4 \times \frac{4}{3} - 5 \times \frac{3}{5}}}\)

\(\Rightarrow \frac{{\frac{5}{3} + 3}}{{\frac{{16}}{3} - 3}}\)

\( \Rightarrow \frac{{\frac{{14}}{3}}}{{\frac{7}{3}}}\)

⇒ 2

So, the value is 2.

∴  sin θ = 4/5

गणना:

लंब = P, कर्ण = H और आधार = B.

sin θ = P/H = 4/5

P = 4 और H = 5

⇒ sec θ = 1/cos θ = 5/3

tan θ = P/B = 4/3

cot θ = 1/tan θ = 3/4

अब,

\(\frac{{sec\theta + 4\cot \theta }}{{4tan\theta - 5cos\theta }}\)

\( \Rightarrow \frac{{\frac{5}{3} + 4 \times \frac{3}{4}}}{{4 \times \frac{4}{3} - 5 \times \frac{3}{5}}}\)

\(\Rightarrow \frac{{\frac{5}{3} + 3}}{{\frac{{16}}{3} - 3}}\)

question: Sudha sold an article to Renu for Rs. 576 at a loss of 20% Renu spent a sum of Rs. 224 on its transportation and sold it to Raghu at a price which would have given Sudha a profit of 24%. The percentage of gain for Renu is:
question_hi: सुधा ने रेनू को एक वस्तु 20% की हानि पर 576 रुपये में बेची। रेनू ने इसके परिवहन पर 224 व्यय किये और इसे रघु को उस कीमत पर बेच दिया, जिससे सुधा को 24% का लाभ होता। रेनू का लाभ प्रतिशत है:
solution:
Sudha sold an article to Renu for = Rs. 576

Cost price of the article for Sudha = Rs. 576 × (100/80) = Rs. 720

Final cost price of the article for Renu = 576 + 224 = Rs. 800

Profit gain on the article for Renu = Rs. 720 × (124/100) = Rs. 892.8

Profit percentage on the article for Renu = (92.8/800) × 100 = 11.6%
solution_hi:
सुधा ने रेणु को = 576 रुपये में एक वस्तु बेची

सुधा के लिए वस्तु का क्रय मूल्य = 576 रु. × (100/80) = 720 रु.

रेनू के लिए वस्तु का अंतिम क्रय मूल्य = 576 + 224 = 800 रु.

रेनू के लिए वस्तु पर लाभ = 720 रु. × (124/100) = 892.8 रु.

रेनू के लिए वस्तु पर लाभ प्रतिशत = (92.8/800) × 100 = 11.6%

question: The total exports of item D in 2010, 2012 and 2014 is what percentage of the total exports of all the four items in 2011 and 2012?

question: A train takes \(2\frac{1}{2}\)hours less for a journey of 300 km, if its speed is increased by 20 km/h from its usual speed. How much time will it take to cover a distance of 192 km at its usual speed?
question_hi: एक ट्रेन 300 किमी की यात्रा के लिए ​​\(2\frac{1}{2}\) घंटे कम लेती है, यदि इसकी गति सामान्य गति से 20 किमी/घंटा बढ़ जाती है। अपनी सामान्य गति से 192 किमी की दूरी तय करने में उसे कितना समय लगेगा?
solution:
Given:

A train takes \(2\frac{1}{2}\)hours less for a journey of 300 km, if its speed is increased by 20 km/h from its usual speed.

Formula Used:

Speed = Distance/Time

Calculation:

\(2\frac{1}{2} = \frac{5}{2}\)

Let speed of train be x km/hr

According to the question

[300/x] – [300/(x + 20)] = 5/2

⇒ 300 [x + 20 – x]/[x (x + 20) = 5/2

⇒ 6000/(x2 + 20x) = 5/2

⇒ 12000 = 5x2 + 100x

⇒ x2 + 20x – 2400 = 0

⇒ x2 + 60x – 40x – 2400 = 0

⇒ x (x + 60) – 40 (x + 60) = 0

⇒ (x + 60) (x – 40) = 0

Taking,

⇒ (x – 40) = 0

⇒ x = 40 km/hr

Speed of the train = 40 km/hr

∴ Time taken to cover 192 km by train = 192/40 = 4.8 hrs

Shortcut Trick Let the usual speed = x

Increased  speed is (x + 20)

[300/x] – [300/(x + 20)] = 5/2

Using different values x = 40, - 60

As speed is 40.

Time taken to cover 192/40 = 4.8hrs
solution_hi:
दिया हुआ

एक ट्रेन को 300 किमी की यात्रा के लिए घंटे कम लगते हैं, अगर इसकी गति अपनी सामान्य गति से 20 किमी / घंटा बढ़ जाती है।

प्रयुक्त सूत्र

गति = दूरी / समय

गणना

​​\(2\frac{1}{2} = \frac{5}{2}\)

माना ट्रेन की गति x किमी/घंटा है

प्रश्न के अनुसार

[300/x] – [300/(x + 20)] = 5/2

⇒ 300 [x + 20 – x]/[x (x + 20) = 5/2

⇒ 6000/(x2 + 20x) = 5/2

⇒ 12000 = 5x2 + 100x

⇒ x2 + 20x – 2400 = 0

⇒ x2 + 60x – 40x – 2400 = 0

⇒ x (x + 60) – 40 (x + 60) = 0

⇒ (x + 60) (x – 40) = 0

लेने पर,

⇒ (x – 40) = 0

⇒ x = 40 किमी/घंटा

ट्रेन की गति = 40 किमी/घंटा

∴ ट्रेन से 192 किमी की दूरी तय करने में समय लगा = 192/40 = 4.8 घंटे

question: If 12cos2 θ – 2sin2θ + 3cosθ = 3, 0° < θ < 90°, then what is the value of \( \frac{{cosec\theta + sec\theta }}{{tan\theta + cot\;\theta }}?\)
question_hi: यदि 12cos2 θ – 2sin2θ + 3cosθ = 3, 0° < θ < 90° है, तो \(\frac{{cosec\theta + sec\theta }}{{tan\theta + cot\;\theta }}\) का मान क्या है?
solution:
12cos2 θ – 2sin2θ + 3cosθ = 3

⇒ 12 cos2 θ – 2 (1 – cos2 θ) + 3 cos θ = 3

⇒ 12 cos2 θ – 2 + 2 cos2 θ + 3 cos θ = 3

⇒ 14 cos2 θ + 3 cos θ – 5 = 0

⇒ 14 cos2 θ + 10 cos θ – 7 cos θ – 5 = 0

⇒ 2 cos θ (7 cos θ + 5) – 1 (7cos θ + 5) = 0

⇒ (2 cos θ – 1) (7 cos θ + 5) = 0

Taking,

(2 cos θ – 1) = 0

⇒ cos θ = 1/2

⇒ cos θ = cos 60

⇒ θ = 60

\( \Rightarrow \frac{{cosec\theta + sec\theta }}{{tan\theta + cot\;\theta }}\)

\( \Rightarrow \frac{{cosec60 + sec60}}{{tan60 + cot\;60}}\)

\( \Rightarrow \frac{{\frac{2}{{\sqrt 3 }} + 2}}{{\sqrt 3 + \frac{1}{{\sqrt 3 }}}}\)

\( \Rightarrow \frac{{\frac{{2\sqrt 3 + 2}}{{\sqrt 3 }}}}{{\frac{4}{{\sqrt 3 }}}}\)

\( \Rightarrow \frac{{\sqrt 3 + 1}}{2}\)

question: The compound interest on a certain sum at 16\(\frac{2}{3}\)% p. a for 3 years is Rs. 6,350 What will be the simple interest on the same at the same rate for \(5\frac{2}{3}\) years?
question_hi: एक निश्चित राशि पर 16\(\frac{2}{3}\)% प्रति वार्षिक दर से 3 वर्ष के लिए चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज 6,350 रु. है। \(5\frac{2}{3}\)वर्षों के लिए समान दर पर साधारण ब्याज क्या होगा?
solution:
Detailed Method:

Rate = \(16\frac{2}{3} = \frac{{50}}{3}{\rm{\% }}\)
Time = 3 years

CI = 6350

As we know,

CI = P [(1 + r/100)3 – 1]

6350 = P [{1 + (50/3 × 100)3} – 1]

⇒ 6350 = P [(1 + 1/6)3 – 1]

⇒ 6350 = P [(7/6)3 – 1]

⇒ 6350 = P [343/216 – 1]

⇒ 6350 = P [127/216]

⇒ P = 6350 × (216/127)

⇒ P = 10800

Now,

P = 10800, \(r = 16\frac{2}{3}\% = \frac{{50}}{3}\% \;and\;T = 5\frac{2}{3} = \frac{{17}}{3}year\;\) 

As we know,

SI = Prt/100

SI = (10800 × 50 × 17)/(3 × 3 × 100)

SI = 10200

Short trick:

Rate = \(16\frac{2}{3} = \frac{1}{6}\) and time = 3 years and CI = 6350

Ratio of P to A = 63 : 73 = 216 : 343

⇒ 343 – 216 = 127

⇒ 127 unit = 6350

⇒ 1 unit = 50

⇒ 216 unit = 10,800

Now,

P = 10800, \(r = 16\frac{2}{3}\% = \frac{{50}}{3}\% \;and\;T = 5\frac{2}{3} = \frac{{17}}{3}year\;\) 

Interest rate for 1 year = 50/3 %

Interest rate for 17/3 year = 850/9 %

Simple interest = 10800 × (850/900) = 10200

Hint:

As given, time = 17/3 years

So, we can say answer divisible by 17. Only option 2 is divisible by 17.
solution_hi:
विस्तृत विधि:

दर = \(16\frac{2}{3} = \frac{{50}}{3}{\rm{\% }}\)
समय = 3 वर्ष

चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज = 6350

जैसा कि हम जानते हैं,

चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज = P [(1 + r/100)3 – 1]

6350 = P [{1 + (50/3 × 100)3} – 1]

⇒ 6350 = P [(1 + 1/6)3 – 1]

⇒ 6350 = P [(7/6)3 – 1]

⇒ 6350 = P [343/216 – 1]

⇒ 6350 = P [127/216]

⇒ P = 6350 × (216/127)

⇒ P = 10800

अब,

P = 10800, \(r = 16\frac{2}{3}\% = \frac{{50}}{3}\% \;and\;T = 5\frac{2}{3} = \frac{{17}}{3}\) वर्ष

जैसा कि हम जानते हैं,

SI = Prt/100

SI = (10800 × 50 × 17)/(3 × 3 × 100)

SI = 10200

लघु विधि:

दर = \(16\frac{2}{3} = \frac{1}{6}\) और समय = 3 वर्ष और चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज = 6350

P और A का अनुपात = 63 : 73 = 216 : 343

⇒ 343 – 216 = 127

⇒ 127 इकाई = 6350

⇒ 1 इकाई = 50

⇒ 216 इकाई = 10,800

अब,

P = 10800, \(r = 16\frac{2}{3}\% = \frac{{50}}{3}\% \;and\;T = 5\frac{2}{3} = \frac{{17}}{3}\) वर्ष

1 वर्ष के लिए ब्याज दर = 50/3 %

17/3 वर्ष के लिए ब्याज दर = 850/9 %

साधारण ब्याज = 10800 × (850/900) = 10200

संकेत:

जैसा कि दिया गया है, समय = 17/3 वर्ष

तो, हम उत्तर को 17 से विभाज्य कह सकते हैं। केवल विकल्प 2, 17 से विभाज्य है।

question: If the nine-digit number 708x6y8z9 is divisible by 99 then what is the value of x + y + z?
question_hi: एक नौ-अंकीय संख्या 708x6y8z9 99 से विभाज्य है, तो x + y + z का मान क्या है?
solution:
Divisibility law of 11: If the difference of the alternating sum of digits of the number is a multiple of 11 (e.g. 2343 is divisible by 11 because 2 – 3 + 4 – 3 = 0, which is a multiple of 11).

Divisibility  law of 9 ⇒ A number is divisible by 9 if the sum of its digit is divisible by 9.

The nine–digit number 708x6y8z9 is divisible by 99. So we can say number also divisible by 9 and 11.

7 + 0 + 8 + x + 6 + y + 8 + z + 9

⇒ 38 + x + y + z

Put the value of (x + y + z) from the option one by one.

If we put (x + y + z) = 16, then

⇒ 38 + 16

⇒ 54

As we know, 54 divisible by 9.

If we put (x + y + z) = 27, then

⇒ 38 + 27 

⇒ 65

65 is not divisible by 9

If we put (x + y + z) = 9, then

⇒ 38 + 9 

⇒ 47

47 is not divisible by 9

If we put (x + y + z) = 5, then

⇒ 38 + 5

⇒43

43 is not divisble by 9

Thus, the correct answer is 16.
